projects.name: Using Eye Condition to Predict Blood Pressure
projects.summary: I came up with a project idea to apply what I had learned in online courses to a personal problem. I aimed to answer the driving question:

. Using iPhone photos, colab, neural networks, and the Fast.Ai visual classification library to build a basic model that would help determine if blood pressure is learnable from eye features. The NN could classify eye images as high or low blood pressure based on specific features. I'm currently working on a CNN  the utilizes Pytorch and Lightning AI, as well as developing a more controlled dataset.
